messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick heads up — FinSecure wants a few customer-specific config changes before we finish onboarding. They asked: rate limit increase, allowlist a couple IP ranges, and enable the eu-west region for data residency. Also flagged renewal as an at-risk item if latency/throughput issues persist.
Sam (Infra): Got it. Can you paste their account id and current plan? Rate limit increases need review for multi-tenant safety.
Maya (CSM): Account: FS-7721. Currently on Dedicated Starter (monthly). They need burst from 60->600 requests/min for their webhook route (/api/v1/generate).
Priya (AE): Noted — FinSecure's legal is slow, but they hinted at upgrade if we can hit 99% p95 latency under 250ms and enable eu-west. Renewal in 11 months — potential upsell.
Sam (Infra): Two parts: 1) rate limits — we can create a per-account per-route quota in the gateway, but need approval to relax global safety throttles. 2) allowlist — we need exact CIDR list and proof of ownership for each IP. 3) region — provisioning eu-west is a schedulable work item (may take 24–48h).
Maya (CSM): CIDRs they provided: 52.88.0.0/18 and 3.248.0.0/17. They also want outbound traffic to come from eu-west. FinSecure Admin confirmed via DM.
Carlos (Security): Quick ask: will these IPs be static? We need an SLA addendum for allowlisted IPs and a signed Acceptable Use confirmation. Can Legal escalate?
Maya (CSM): I can get the signed doc today. Priya — can you nudge Legal?
Priya (AE): On it, pinged legal thread.
Sam (Infra): I started a change window request. If legal signoff and account owner ok, we can do a staged rollout: create a per-account rate-limit bucket, route traffic to eu-west endpoints (provisioned), then lift global safety cap for that account. I put the rough CLI steps below — will run with ops after approvals.
Sam (Infra): ```
# provisional commands (internal) - DO NOT RUN in prod without approvals
redwoodctl accounts update --id FS-7721 --set "ratelimit.route:/api/v1/generate=600/min"
redwoodctl allowlist add --account FS-7721 --cidr 52.88.0.0/18 --note "FinSecure"
redwoodctl allowlist add --account FS-7721 --cidr 3.248.0.0/17 --note "FinSecure"
redwoodctl regions enable --account FS-7721 --region eu-west-1
# validate with smoke tests and p95 latency checks
```
Jules (Enablement): Once region is live we can schedule a 30m enablement call to validate their integration and run sample load tests. I can do Wed morning.
FinSecure Admin: Thanks — legal has the doc, I'll share the signed copy in this thread by EOD. Also we can accept a phased increase (200 -> 400 -> 600) if safer.
Sam (Infra): Perfect — phased rollout is preferred. I'll mark the request P1 for scheduling but will only execute after security/legal signoff and you (Maya) confirm the phased plan.
ops-bot: CHANGE-REQ-48572 created by Sam. SLA: standard change window, notify CS and AE.
Maya (CSM): I'll gather the signed doc and confirm the phased schedule once I have it. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
